shiplink.copied.one: 1 of them is a copy, not a link: {folder} is on another volume or its file system has no hard links
shiplink.copied.other: {count} of them are copies, not links: {folder} is on another volume or its file system has no hard links
shiplink.in_use: {program} is in use, so {folder} keeps its old copy. The new build is in the tool's folder.
shiplink.none: the build made no file to ship to {folder}
shiplink.none.remedy: run smith doctor to check where the tool builds
